Weave Platform (https://www.weave.bio/) | San Francisco, CA | HYBRID | FULLTIME

Regulatory AI SaaS for Biotech | Weave Bio is a <50 person Series A start-up building an AI-native regulatory automation management platform for novel therapeutic candidates (specialty drug development).

Hiring: - Senior or Staff Backend Engineer (Django + Python)

- Senior or Staff Frontend Engineer (Typescript + React)

- Staff DevOps Engineer (AWS, Linux, SRE)

- Senior Product Designer

- Senior Product Manager

- Senior/Lead SDR

Apply here: https://www.weave.bio/careers-at-weave-bio/

In-office days are Tues/Wed/Thurs; WFH days are Mon/Fri.
